title: Complaint/Compliment
description: ***Web Users - Some users may experience an issue submitting this SR type on the customer web portal. Customers unable to submit at this time can download our mobile app or contact 311 to submit their request with an agent.*** Use this service request to make a complaint or compliment regarding a service request, a City of Dallas department, or an employee. Please allow 30 days from the time an SR is closed to report the same issue. The estimated response time for a service request of this nature is 2 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to complain about a City service, department, or employee.
actions.why: To report a complaint about a City of Dallas service request, department, or employee. The 311 request form covers unresolved or prematurely closed service requests, incorrect information, exceeded response time or service agreement, poor work quality, City policy or procedures, employee conduct, property damage, technology, unsafe driving, and Sanitation collection, roll-cart, or worker issues.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Complaint/Compliment" requests is not the recommended route for Sanitation Services Alley to Curb changes or a repeat report of the same closed service request before 30 days have passed. If your concern involves Sanitation Services Alley to Curb changes, then submit the Sanitation form or email Sanitation Services. If you are reporting the same issue less than 30 days after a service request was closed, then wait until 30 days have passed from its closure before reporting it again.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Complaint/Compliment"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to compliment a City service, department, or employee.
actions.why: To recognize a City of Dallas service request, department, or employee for positive service. The 311 request form offers compliment topics such as customer service, timely response, attention to detail, helpful information, quality of work, safe driving, or another topic, and asks what compliments the requester has for the department.
actions.why_not: The online form for a "Complaint/Compliment" request is not the directed route for a compliment about Sanitation Services Alley to Curb changes. If the compliment concerns Sanitation Services Alley to Curb changes, then submit the Sanitation form or email Sanitation Services.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Complaint/Compliment"

actions.tagline: Contact Sanitation Services about Alley to Curb changes.
actions.why: For a complaint or compliment about Sanitation Services Alley to Curb changes. The 311 request form asks whether the collection service is Brush/Bulk, Garbage, Recycling, or Other; the Dallas 311 website then directs people who answer Yes to a Sanitation form or email.
actions.how: Submit the Sanitation Alley to Curb form or email SAN.CurbTransition@dallas.gov
actions.how_formatted: Submit the [Sanitation Alley to Curb form](https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=nnA1KQzBCUijAoUtNp-HAIsiy0iNucBJkpI55OlFnQpURTRRTFBOV1FJV1BOMUk1NTVaWkVXQ1RTMSQlQCN0PWcu) or email [SAN.CurbTransition@dallas.gov](mailto:SAN.CurbTransition@dallas.gov)
